tagline.en_US: Manage files through a browser interface with upload, download and user permissions. The container can use a local repository and file-based application settings without an external database.

description.en_US: FileGator is a self-hosted web application for managing files and folders. It allows users to manage files in a local directory or connect to various external storage systems. The application includes multi-user support with custom roles, access permissions, and individual home directories. It supports standard file operations such as viewing, editing, uploading, downloading, and creating zip archives directly in the browser.
